# EXPO: The Human Condition Guide - Terminal Locations

With thanks to Coffee888.

****SUBJECT TO CHANGE PORTING TO LIVE SERVERS****

There are 9 possible spawn locations for the Defence Terminals, with only 3 spawning per expedition.

All 3 will spawn at the same time and they can be activated in any order, by both the Team Leader and Teammates.

__Map of Community Center__

Downloadable copy __here__.

__Terminal Locations__

**Location # 1**

Lobby

From the lobby, go up the stairs in front of you and turn right. Follow the stairs to the top and face NE. Walk towards the double doorway in front of you and you will see the terminal on the desk.

**Location # 2**

Lobby

From the lobby, head North. Ignore the stairs and walk around them. The Terminal is on a desk, behind the stairs.

**Location # 3**

Library

On the left of the stairs in the lobby, is the library entrance. Enter the second door (right side) and turn right. The Terminal is in the NE corner of the room, on the desk.

**Location # 4**

From the lobby, go up the stairs in front of you. Turn right and follow the stairs to the top. Veer slightly left and keep walking North, past the wagon in the middle.

Stop at the hole in the floor and turn right. Walk straight, past the door on your left and turn left into the hole in the wall just past the door.

The Terminal is on a desk at the back of the room.

**Location # 5**

Swimming Pool

On the right of the stairs in the lobby, is the Swimming Pool entrance. Enter the first door (right side) and follow the path through the locker room, to the pool area.

Face East and look for the blue door and the red exit sign on the far wall. Walk over to the door and turn NW. The Terminal will be in front of you, near the top of the slide.

**Location # 6**

Gym

From the lobby, head North. Ignore the stairs and walk around them. Keep walking forward and turn right when you walk past the "Tickets" window.

Go down the first flight of stairs and keep walking East. Go up the stairs and turn left at the door. Face North and walk forward. The Terminal is inside the tent, in front of you.

**Location # 7**

Gym

From the lobby, head North. Ignore the stairs and walk around them. Keep walking forward and turn right when you walk past the "Tickets" window.

Go down the first flight of stairs and keep walking East. Go up the stairs and turn left at the door. Face North, walk forward, and jump over the tent in front of you.

At the front of the tent, face East and walk forward until you hit the wall.

Face North and the Terminal is on the metal cabinet in front of you.

**Location # 8**

Theater

From the front door, head North. Ignore the stairs and walk around them instead.

Walk under the "theater" sign and go up the stairs in front of you.

At the top of the stairs turn right and follow the path around until you get to the balcony.

Jump off the balcony and walk forward until you hit the North wall.

Turn right and follow the path around. Open the first door on your right and the Terminal will be in the corner, on a card table.

**Location # 9**

Theater

From the front door, head North. Ignore the stairs and walk around them instead.

Walk under the "theater" sign and go up the stairs in front of you.

At the top of the stairs turn right and follow the path around until you get to the balcony.

Jump off the balcony and face South. Walk forward and you will see the Sound Room on your right. The Terminal is inside the Sound Room, against the South wall, on the desk.

**Location # 10**

From the front door, head North. Ignore the stairs and walk around them instead.

Walk under the "theater" sign and go up the stairs in front of you.

At the top of the stairs turn right and follow the path around until you get to the balcony.

Jump off the balcony onto the ground floor. Face NW and walk straight, under the stage.

Look for a flooded room, in the NW corner. The Terminal is on the desk.
